notes:
August 3rd 2026
Version 13.3+ (stable) / 13.4+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Program names and file names now stay in sync. (R)
* Song and loop links no longer lost. (R)
* Long song and loop paths show in full. (R)
* CSV and HTML exports match the printed report. (R)
* Major Roland framework changes. (R)
* Mandatory upgrade for all users. (K,R)
notes_beta:
August 7th 2026
Version 13.3+ (stable) / 13.4+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Find Matches: click a program and every file holding the same sounds lights up. (R)
* Drag a program from the tree onto the browser to save it as a .UPG file. (R)
* Browse a folder of scene files right beside the tree. (K)
* Drag a .sca or .rif scene file into the tree to add it to a bank. (K)
* Sync scene names to file names across a whole library in one step. (K)
* The License tab no longer tells paying customers they are "Not activated". (K,R)
